entities.summary: Robert Offley Ashburton Crewe-Milnes, 1st Marquess of Crewe, known as The Honourable Robert Milnes from 1863 to 1885, The Lord Houghton from 1885 to 1895, and as The Earl of Crewe from 1895 to 1911, was a British Liberal politician, statesman and writer.
